headline: Approved Stop & Shop sign permit at 2265 Northampton Street; continued hearings on Suffolk Street parking and Beech Street fence.
summary: Staff will draft a recommendation letter on a zone change for 172 Sargeant Street. A land division at 2 Fini Road to create a private cemetery was approved, and hearings on general business sign rules and native plant rules were continued.
decisions: Approved the notice of decision for Stop & Shop's larger sign plan at 2265 Northampton Street, 5-0.
Continued the fence height special permit for 230-232 Beech Street to September 22, 2026, to allow a site visit.
Voted to close the hearing on the zone change at 172 Sargeant Street and have staff draft a recommendation letter.
Voted to close the hearing on BG sign rules and have staff draft a recommendation letter.
Approved signing the ANR plan for 2 Fini Road (179-00-003), 5-0.
Continued the BG sign rules hearing (ZC 2026-7) to September 22, 2026, 5-0.
Continued the parking special permit hearing for 61-69 Suffolk Street to September 22, 2026, 5-0.
Continued the native plants zone change hearing (ZC 2026-4) to October 13, 2026, 5-0.
